timing_scope: Process wall time around the fixed-work inference invocations, including startup and model loading. Source overlay preparation and separate trace runs are excluded.
comparison: The normalized Quiver comparison removes known output-path prefixes from tag fields. All other payload bytes, including atom order, coordinates, residue identities, and score text, are compared.

raw_internal_trace.coverage: One fixed candidate with initial state, each recycle, coordinates, confidence scores, selected recycle, and RNG states.
